prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a low-speed head-on collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1197; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents front-end damage consistent with the reported low-speed head-on impact, including the bumper cover, hood leading edge, and both headlamp assemblies, with the radiator support showing minor displacement. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and headlamps, straightening the support, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested align with the extent of the damage observed. The submitted invoices show no repeated charges. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the inspection.
